The wall initially had 3 courses of bricks, so it had 3*400 = 1200 bricks.
They added 2 more courses, so the wall had 2+3 = 5 courses.
The wall now has 5*400 = 2000 bricks.
They took out half of the bricks in the last course, so they took out 400/2 = 200 bricks.
The wall now has 2000-200 = 1800 bricks.
#### 1800

Let's say David's age is x
Yuan is 7 years older than David, so Yuan's age is x+7
Yuan is also twice David's age, so x+7=2x
Subtracting x from both sides, we get 7=x
Therefore, David is 7 years old

The boy squirrel brings 6 walnuts to the burrow, but drops 1 on the way, so there are 6-1 = 5 walnuts left.
The burrow already had 12 walnuts, so there are 5+12 = 17 walnuts in the burrow.
The girl squirrel brings 5 more walnuts, so there are 17+5 = 22 walnuts in the burrow.
The girl squirrel eats 2 walnuts, so there are 22-2 = 20 walnuts left.
#### 20

Cheryl spends $800 x $400 = $3200 on her monthly cell phone expenses.
The cost of the golf tournament is $4000 x 20/100 = $800 more than her monthly cell phone expenses.
Therefore, the cost of the golf tournament is $4000 + $800 = $4800.
Hence, Cheryl pays $4800 upon signing up for the golf tournament.

Each fence panel is made of 3 metal sheets, and 2 metal beams, so each panel is made of 3 + 2 = 5 metal rods.
The fence is made of 10 fence panels, so the community needs 10 * 5 = 50 metal rods for the panels.
Each sheet is made of 10 metal rods, so the community needs 3 * 10 = 30 metal rods for the sheets.
Each metal beam is made of 4 metal rods, so the community needs 2 * 4 = 8 metal rods for the beams.
In total, the community needs 50 + 30 + 8 = 88 metal rods for the fence.
#### 88

The sum of Christine's two cats' weights is 7 + 10 = 17 pounds.
If her dog's weight is twice the sum of her two cats' weights, then her dog weighs 17 x 2 = 34 pounds.

In total, Andy has 30+180 = 210 minks.
Half of the minks are set free, so Andy is left with 210/2 = 105 minks.
It takes 15 mink skins to make a coat, so Andy can make 105/15 = 7 coats.

The total number of cookies is 40+50+30+20 = 140
The chance of Renee picking a peanut butter cookie is 40/140 = 2/7
The chance of Renee picking a lemon cookie is 20/140 = 1/7
The chance of Renee picking a chocolate chip cookie is 50/140 = 5/14
The chance of Renee picking a peanut butter cookie is 2/7 = 40.0%
The chance of Renee picking a lemon cookie is 1/7 = 14.3%
The chance of Renee picking a chocolate chip cookie is 5/14 = 35.7%
The chance of Renee having an allergic reaction is 40.0% + 14.3% + 35.7% = 90.0%
